min.description: the minimum value of the input stream, for string will return string of minimum length

max.description: the maximum value of the input stream, for string will return string of maximum length

invalidCount.description: number of elements that did not match the specified ValueType of this Digest

spec.description: Stores the spec for what statistics were calculated for this Digest

hyperLogLog.description: Stores input data in a HyperLogLog structure used for estimating unique count

countMinSketch.description: Stores input data in a CountMinSketch structure used for estimating frequent elements

minHash.description: Stores hashes of a subset of input data used for approximate inclusion tests

fieldStats.description: Statistics of field values in arbitrary dataset.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

partition.description:
denotes source collection where ObjDigest came from. If the PersistableObjDigest summarizes entire
SourceCollection, field will be null, and id of SourceCollection will match id of PersistableObjDigest
